paper_title: EnvSimBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Improving LLM-Based Environment Simulation
reason: 공식 저장소 README(https://github.com/cookieApril/EnvSimBench)에는 'License-MIT' 배지가 있고 LICENSE 파일 링크만 걸려 있으며, 수집된 카드에는 '## LICENSE file' 절이 없다(license_file: null). 따라서 '미표기' 근거(absence)로는 쓸 수 없고, 이 MIT 표기는 저장소 코드에 대한 표기일 뿐 400개 벤치마크 데이터에 대한 데이터 라이선스로 확인되지 않는다. 데이터는 EnvScaler 환경 191개에서 GPT-4o-mini 에이전트가 수집한 궤적으로 만들어졌고(논문 3쪽 Figure 1, 17쪽 Figure 4), 배지 한 줄만으로는 이 구성 요소 전체에 MIT가 적용되는지 입증되지 않는다. 데이터셋이 실제로 배포되는 Hugging Face 카드(Louie-CookieApril/EnvSimBench)와 LICENSE 파일 본문, EnvScaler 환경의 라이선스는 이번에 제공된 공식 자료에 없어 확인하지 못했다. 또한 상업적 이용·수정·파생·재배포 허용 여부를 직접 밝힌 문장이 없고, 공식 카드에 lm-eval 또는 lm-evaluation-harness 언급이 없으나 라이선스 문구가 있어 absence 증거를 쓸 수 없다. 이 사실들이 확인되기 전에는 공개하지 않는다. Hugging Face 데이터 카드와 저장소 LICENSE 파일을 가져오면 다시 진행할 수 있다. 성능 결과는 논문 4쪽 Table 4(7개 모델의 Overall CM)로 제시할 수 있다.

screening.paper_title: EnvSimBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Improving LLM-Based Environment Simulation
screening.abstract: Scalable AI agents training relies on interactive environments that faithfully simulate the consequences of agent actions. Manually crafted environments are expensive to build, brittle to extend, and fundamentally limited in diversity. A promising direction is to replace manually crafted environments with LLM-simulated counterparts. However, this paradigm hinges on an unexamined core assumption: LLMs can accurately simulate environmental feedback. In practice, LLM-simulated environments suffer from hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, and silent state drift failures that corrupt agent reward signals and compound the construction costs that the paradigm was designed to eliminate. To address this gap, we propose EnvSimBench with four contributions: 1) We provide the first formal definition and operationalization of Environment Simulation Ability (EnvSim Ability) as a quantifiable research objective. 2) We construct EnvSimBench, a rigorous benchmark covering 400 samples across 167 diverse environments, equipped with verifiable labels and fine-grained difficulty stratification along three axes. 3) Systematic evaluations reveal that all state-of-the-art language models suffer from a universal state change cliff: they achieve near-perfect accuracy on tasks when the environment state remains invariant, yet fail catastrophically when multiple states need simultaneous updates. This finding exposes EnvSim Ability as a critical yet largely unaddressed capability gap. 4) We design a constraint-driven simulation pipeline that substantially reduces hallucination, boosts environment synthesis yield by 6.8%, and cuts costs by over 90%. Overall, EnvSimBench serves as both a diagnostic framework and a practical optimization path for reliable LLM-based environment simulation, establishing a foundation for scalable agent training. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cookieApril/EnvSimBench
